entities.summary: Leonid Vasilyevich Potapov was the Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of Buryatia from August 1991 to 1994, and then President of the Buryat Republic in Russia from July 1994 to July 2007. He was reelected three times ; in 2002 he received 68% of the vote.
